text:
Liam Chen: Heads-up — we need to sync on cross-account quota bumps and headroom for Dedicated GPU pools for early April. Forecast says we’ll peak ~72 A100-equivalent GPUs across US-WEST and EU-WEST for a 48-hour window, plus a steady baseline of 120 GPUs. Looking to reserve ~20% headroom and a short burst window of 80 GPUs. Can infra own the quota requests?
Maria Gonzales: Yep, I can start tickets. Which cloud accounts and exact instance families do we need? Also do we want reserved vs on-demand for the baseline? :thinking_face:
Liam Chen: Baseline will be Dedicated (non-preemptible). Instance types: AWS p4d (A100) and GCP a2-highgpu-8g (A100) for now, possibly p5 (H100) in us-west if vendor pricing looks OK. Accounts: AWS 111122223333, GCP redwood-prod-eu, GCP redwood-prod-us. Need increases for vCPU, GPUs, ENIs/secondary IPs, and EIP quotas.
Ben Patel: For burst-only jobs we can shift some workloads to spot/spot-instances to save cost, but Dedicated customers expect non-preemptible. Recommend: baseline committed nodes reserved; burst via a separate burst pool that can be preemptible for non-SLA traffic.
Sarah O'Neill: Network notes — when you add +80 GPUs you'll hit per-subnet IP limits and NAT EIP limits. For GCP we need to increase alias IP ranges and subnet IPs; for AWS check ENI limits per instance type and EIP soft limits. Also check route table entry limits for k8s node pools.
Maria Gonzales: I’ll open tickets. Draft support text below for AWS (copy/edit as needed):
```
Subject: Quota increase request for account 111122223333 — GPUs, ENIs, EIPs
Hello,
We request the following quota increases for account 111122223333 to support short-term Dedicated capacity:
- Elastic GPU (p4d) instance quota: +80 (one-time burst window)
- EIP limit increase: +50
- ENI limit per region: increase to 4000
- VPC subnet IP limit / secondary IPs: increase to support 1200 node IPs
Requested window: 2026-04-05 to 2026-04-08. Please advise on approval timeline.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Infra
```
Ben Patel: Suggest adding optional follow-up: ask for temporary burst reservation or capacity protection if provider offers it (some CSPs have reservation APIs). Also ask for quota in multiple regions at once so we can failover.
Marcus Kim: Cost ping — rough hourly delta for baseline 120 A100s (on-demand) is ~ $33k/hr; with reserved / committed capacity we can cut that ~35%. Burst 80 A100s for 48 hours is ~ $53k one-off. Need finance eyes. @sarah can you estimate network/cloud egress bump?
Sarah O'Neill: Egress looks like +1.2–1.8PB for the burst depending on workload mix. Recommend setting a billing alert at 50% of burst estimate and pre-authorize a $200k cap for the window.
infra-bot: [automated] Quota request checklist: 1) Open support ticket per cloud account; 2) Provide timelines & account IDs; 3) CC infra@redwood.com and billing@redwood.com; 4) Attach capacity forecast CSV.
Liam Chen: Action items: Maria open tickets for listed accounts (AWS +2 regions, GCP us/eu). Sarah validate secondary IP and ENI numbers and paste exact quota names. Ben draft fallback to spot pool for non-Dedicated jobs. Marcus prep cost approval doc and send to finance. I’ll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm ticket IDs.
Maria Gonzales: On it, will paste ticket links here once created. Expect initial replies within 48hrs. :thumbsup: 
Ben Patel: I'll prototype a burst-autoscaler to isolate burst pool and avoid impacting baseline. Will push a demo by EOD.
Liam Chen: Thanks everyone. If cloud asks for exact node counts per zone: US-WEST-2 target 60 GPUs baseline + 40 burst, EU-WEST-1 target 30 baseline + 20 burst. Keep audit trail in infra/quota-requests.
Marcus Kim: Scheduling note — canary drain + capacity test on 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC. I'll add to the calendar and include runbook.
Maria Gonzales: Ticket #AWS-987654 created: requesting p4d and EIP increases for 111122223333. Will paste updates when we hear back.
Liam Chen: Perfect — thanks all.
